violation_type.title: Determining Child/Caregiver Ratios - All Children Included (26 TAC §746.1507(4))
violation_type.short_title: Determining Child/Caregiver Ratios - All Children Included
violation_type.typical_finding: All children present at the operation including the staff?s children are to be included in ratio and must belong in a classroom. It was determined that a staff member's son was present and not being counted in ratio and allowed to go from classroom to classroom.

finding_variants.text: All children present at the operation including the staff?s children are to be included in ratio and must belong in a classroom. It was determined that a staff member's son was present and not being counted in ratio and allowed to go from classroom to classroom.
A child relative (3 years old)  is in the infant room with children ages 6 weeks to 17 months
There was a 12 year old related to a caregiver laying down in the kitchen area.
A child relative is not being counted in ratio.
Based on the information gathered, an employee's child was not included in the child/caregiver ratio when the child was observed unsupervised at the operation.
